This is direct evidence of administrative harassment used to chill dissent.","question_ids":["4B.9","4B.6","4B.3","4B.5","4B.1"]},{"title":"Bangladesh restores internet as students call off jobquota protests","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 29, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/bangladesh-restores-internet-as-students-call-off-jobquota-protests-3540555","summary":"Internet service was restored only after protesters called off the movement and conditions were said to be normalizing. This is the closest counterevidence, but it looks reactive and coercion-driven rather than proof that Hasina protected political freedom.","question_ids":["4B.9","4B.6","4B.3"]}]}
